verdicts.quote: The import commits either every user record or zero user records.
For an invalid record, identify its starting physical line … A rejected file has at least one applicable actionable error.
verdicts.missing: The admin may get only the first actionable error. The specification does not require a reason for every failing row in the same result.

verdicts.quote: A file containing a repeated identity or an identity already held in the destination fails.
The supplied data cannot give a user administrative access or change ordinary account privileges. … Imported users receive the ordinary default permissions for newly created users.
verdicts.missing: Role assignments from the file are prohibited. Whether the default grants can exceed the importer's own access is unspecified.

verdicts.quote: A signed-in non-admin cannot submit an import. … An admin needs ordinary user-creation authority in the destination.
verdicts.missing: The specification gives no separate bulk-import authorization rule for an admin who can already create individual users.

verdicts.quote: The first record contains the headers. … The file is refused with the missing or repeated header identified. … Unrecognized headers are refused.
A single UTF-8 byte-order mark at the start of the file is optional. … The import accepts LF and CRLF as record separators. … Inside the enclosing quotes, a comma, LF, or CRLF is part of the value
If equivalent ordinary creation triggers an invitation, activation message, or administrative creation notice, a rejected import triggers none of those creation notices for its rows.
Check the published limits of 1,048,576 file bytes and 1,000 user records. … A file one byte or one record over its respective limit is refused.
zero-byte file, a file with only a mark or ignored lines, or a valid header with no user records. The attempt is refused as having no user records. … one eligible record. One user is created.
Repeating an upload cannot recreate an identity created by the previous attempt. … A batch containing an identity unavailable under ordinary creation is refused.
whether work may continue after a request ends are unconfirmed. … If the host ends the client request before a result is known, the admin gets an unconfirmed outcome when status is available.
verdicts.missing: The specification leaves background processing undecided and gives no way to receive a final completion result for a background job.

verdicts.quote: A committed import triggers the ordinary notices under their ordinary timing and delivery rules.
verdicts.missing: The specification does not say whether a batch sends all invitations at once or what pacing applies across recipients.

verdicts.quote: Imported users start in the ordinary initial account state. … No CSV cell becomes a credential. … An imported user can use the same account claim, activation, or initial sign-in steps as an equivalent ordinarily created user.
verdicts.missing: The host determines activation status and first sign-in. The specification does not establish whether a password exists when the account is created.

verdicts.quote: After success, rejection, or failure, the raw upload is unavailable as an import download or history item.
verdicts.missing: The file’s storage location during processing and the deletion deadline for any underlying copy are unspecified.

verdicts.quote: Operator visibility covers the attempt time and destination when known, the outcome, and the count on success.
verdicts.missing: The operational record need not identify the importing admin or link the batch to the particular accounts created.

verdicts.quote: Closing the interface gives no cancellation guarantee after submission. … without adding a cancellation feature … an admin should be able to retry a single corrected row using the same workflow
In a healthy target deployment, a valid file at both limits can reach a definitive result.
verdicts.missing: The specification gives neither a maximum elapsed time nor a requirement to show progress during processing.

verdicts.quote: An authorized admin can still create one user through the ordinary entry point with the same accepted fields, validation, defaults, and outcome as before the import release. … The import leaves existing users unmodified.

Formula-like text, markup, and URLs in a field are processed only as candidate account data. … Uploading or viewing the result cannot execute or fetch them … both make the same decision about its allowed characters, format, length
